about: The reviewed alias list for data/graph1001.json (scripts/graph1001-build.js). 'same': records in different 1001 datasets that are ONE company, merged under one id. 'not_same': name or website matches that are different companies, so the build stops listing them as candidates. Refs: s startup (census id), i investor (slug), b BUMN (slug), u BUMN subsidiary (group/slug), c chain outside company (key), w data-centre web entity (web/id), n network (AS number), e exporter (id), k a company only named in a link (slug of its name). Reviewed 21 Oct 2026 by reading each record's own name, legal name and description; a record whose identity could not be confirmed stays apart. Brands go with the company that runs them (neuCentrIX -> NeutraDC); a group and its local company stay apart (Digital Edge vs Digital Edge Indonesia, AWS vs Amazon Data Services Indonesia) and are tied by the webs' own owns links.
